title: Design System: Lakshya Jain — Personal Site

display.purpose: The homepage hero name only — the single loudest use of the chalk script.

headline.purpose: Every page's opening title, one script headline per screen.

body.purpose: All prose, subheads, stat values, chip text.

label.purpose: Printed-ticket/receipt-register microcopy only: bio line, table-status, menu subhead, footer stub.

shadows.name: pinned-paper
shadows.purpose: `.soft-card`'s resting shadow, paired with a terracotta push-pin dot — reads as paper pinned above the table.

shadows.name: chalkboard-hung
shadows.purpose: `.menu-board`'s heavier shadow, paired with a thick wood-frame border.

shadows.name: ticket-chit-rest
shadows.purpose: `.ticket-btn` at rest — hard, zero-blur, scoped exclusively to ticket-style buttons.

shadows.name: ticket-chit-pressed
shadows.purpose: `.ticket-btn` hover/focus, paired with translateY(2px) — the button presses down like a die-cut chit.

motion.name: ticket-press
motion.value: transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease; hover/focus: translateY(2px)

motion.name: chalk-fill
motion.purpose: .chalk-highlight fill-in on mount; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: steam-rise
motion.value: translateY(0→-12px) scaleX(1→0.9), opacity .55→.9→0, 2.4s ease-in-out infinite, staggered per path
motion.purpose: The coffee-cup mark's steam curls; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: live-pulse
motion.purpose: The Contact page's 'open to new roles' status dot; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Ticket Button (Primary)
components.description: The order-ticket CTA: terracotta fill, hard offset shadow, presses down on hover/focus. Used for the nav 'Say hi' and the Contact email-copy button.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--terracotta, #c1502e); color: #fff8ec; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--terracotta-strong, #9c3d20); transition: transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--terracotta-strong, #9c3d20); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--terracotta-strong, #9c3d20); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ticket Button (Quiet)
components.description: The lower-emphasis ghost variant: card fill, bordered, no shadow, no press animation. Used for the recruiter 'skip to the plain page' toggle.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-quiet">I’m a recruiter — skip to the plain page</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--card, #fffaf0); color: var(--ink, #3a2317); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e0c79a); border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover, .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { transform: none; box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--terracotta-strong, #9c3d20); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Soft Card
components.description: The signature pinned-paper card: card-cream surface, hairline border, blurred coffee-tinted shadow, and a small terracotta push-pin dot at the top-left corner. Used for the hero panel, Work/Writing rows, the About stat list, and the Contact panel.

components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; background: var(--card, #fffaf0); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e0c79a); border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -10px rgba(58, 35, 23, 0.28); } .ds-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -6px; left: 28px; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--terracotta, #c1502e); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(58, 35, 23, 0.4); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; color: var(--ink, #3a2317); margin: 0; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--ink-soft, #7a5b45); margin: 4px 0 0; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Mustard pill used for project tags on Work rows.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: var(--mustard, #f3dfae); color: var(--ink, #3a2317); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: Sticky, translucent-blur nav with a circular terracotta monogram badge, a Caveat wordmark, underline-hover links, and a ticket-button CTA.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; background: rgba(244, 230, 207, 0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e0c79a); } .ds-nav-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; max-width: 768px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 12px 24px; } .ds-nav-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-badge { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--terracotta, #c1502e); color: #fff8ec; font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; font-size: 18px; } .ds-nav-word { font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; font-size: 24px; color: var(--ink, #3a2317); } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-soft, #7a5b45); text-decoration: none; background-image: linear-gradient(var(--terracotta, #c1502e), var(--terracotta, #c1502e)); background-position: 0 100%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: 0% 2px; transition: background-size .2s ease, color .2s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { background-size: 100% 2px; color: var(--ink, #3a2317); }

components.name: Menu Board
components.description: The signature component: the site's real navigation styled as a cafe chalkboard drink list. Chalkboard-green fill, thick wood-frame border, Caveat title, mono subhead, dashed-divided rows with a label/note pair and an arrow that nudges on hover.
components.html:
The Menu

EVERYTHING ON THIS SITE, TODAY

  • Aboutwho this is, off the menu
  • Worka few things he’s made
components.css: .ds-menu-board { background: var(--chalk, #2c4a37); border: 10px solid #6b4a30; border-radius: 12px; padding: 40px; box-shadow: 0 16px 32px -14px rgba(58, 35, 23, 0.5); } .ds-menu-title { font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; font-weight: 700; font-size: 30px; color: var(--mustard, #f3dfae); margin: 0; } .ds-menu-subtitle { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: rgba(243, 223, 174, 0.7); margin: 4px 0 0; } .ds-menu-list { list-style: none; margin: 24px 0 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-menu-item { border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(243, 223, 174, 0.25); } .ds-menu-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; } .ds-menu-link { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 0; text-decoration: none; } .ds-menu-label { display: block; font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; font-size: 24px; color: #fff8ec; transition: color .2s ease; } .ds-menu-note { display: block; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: rgba(243, 223, 174, 0.7); } .ds-menu-arrow { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; color: rgba(243, 223, 174, 0.7); transition: transform .2s ease, color .2s ease; } .ds-menu-link:hover .ds-menu-label, .ds-menu-link:focus-visible .ds-menu-label { color: var(--mustard, #f3dfae); } .ds-menu-link:hover .ds-menu-arrow, .ds-menu-link:focus-visible .ds-menu-arrow { transform: translate(2px, -2px); color: var(--mustard, #f3dfae); }

narrative.overview: The homepage is a warm cafe table: a hand-lettered name sign, a one-line order-ticket bio clipped like a printed chit, a steaming coffee-cup mark, and a chalkboard menu board that lists every real section — About, Work, Writing, Photos, Say hi — the way a cafe lists its drinks. The chalkboard is the site's primary navigation, not a decoration beside it. This is the third full visual identity this project has carried in one session; it replaces both an isometric 'room' world and a templated gradient-hero portfolio tried earlier, in favor of a genre the user pinned directly: a 90s NYC coffeehouse hangout. The genre is expressed through material (chalkboard, order tickets, corduroy-couch terracotta, brick, photo-strip framing) rather than through any literal show asset — no trademarked logo, character name or likeness, or title typeface appears anywhere in the shipped UI. The system is deliberately warm and communal rather than slick: flat color fields carry real (not faked-photorealistic) offset and blur shadows, the display face is a genuine chalk-marker script rather than the generic AI-cream-plus-serif pairing, and the one hard, printed-ticket-style shadow is earned narrowly by the order-ticket vocabulary rather than applied as a general 'brutalist' habit. A separate, deliberately plain recruiter fallback (SimpleFallback) strips all of this chrome back to the shared base tokens only — proof the coffeehouse dressing is a world choice, not the only way the content can be read.
keyCharacteristics: The chalkboard is the navigation: every real destination is a menu-board row, not a nav-bar-only pattern layered on top of separate page content.

One actionable accent: corduroy-couch terracotta carries every button, link-hover, and focus ring; mustard and chalkboard-green stay confined to their own materials (tags/chips, and the menu board itself).
Chalk script for signage, not for prose: Caveat appears on headlines, titles, and the menu board; body copy is always IBM Plex Sans.
Order-ticket mono: IBM Plex Mono marks only printed-ticket/receipt-style microcopy — not a general technical-label device.

Soft by default, hard by exception: elevated surfaces use blurred, coffee-tinted shadows; only the ticket-style buttons use a hard, zero-blur offset shadow, because they represent a literal printed chit.

Honest, not fabricated: bracketed placeholder copy is styled distinctly (italic, muted) rather than hidden or faked with invented specifics — a convention that predates this redesign and carries forward unchanged.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Terracotta (and its strong companion) is the only color used for actionable UI — buttons, link hovers, focus rings, status dots. Mustard, chalk, and brick are never substituted in for it; each stays confined to the one material it names.

rules.name: The Script-Stays-Loud Rule
rules.body: Caveat is reserved for headlines, titles, and signage-scale labels; it never sets continuous paragraph text. Body copy is always IBM Plex Sans.

rules.name: The Ticket-Register Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono marks printed-ticket/receipt-style microcopy specifically (order lines, table-status, menu subheads, the footer stub) — it is not a general 'technical' or 'code' label device.

rules.name: The Soft-By-Default Rule
rules.body: General elevation (cards, the menu board) is always a blurred, coffee-tinted offset shadow — never a hard, zero-blur edge.

rules.name: The Printed-Ticket Exception
rules.body: The one hard, zero-blur offset shadow in the system (0 3px 0 var(--terracotta-strong)) is scoped exclusively to .ticket-btn / .ticket-btn-quiet, because it represents a literal order-ticket or menu-chit object this world already names. It is not a general 'this project uses hard shadows' style — this world is coffeehouse/paper, not neobrutalist, and the exception must not be generalized to any other surface.

dos: Do keep terracotta (#c1502e) as the only actionable-accent color — buttons, link-hovers, focus rings, and status dots. Mustard, chalk, and brick stay confined to their own named materials.
Do scope the hard 0 3px 0 ticket-chit shadow to .ticket-btn/.ticket-btn-quiet only. All other elevation stays soft and blurred.
Do reserve IBM Plex Mono for printed-ticket/receipt-register microcopy (bio lines, table-status labels, menu subheads, the footer stub) — not a general technical-label typeface.
Do keep Caveat (.display-face) to headlines, titles, and signage-scale labels only; body copy is always IBM Plex Sans.
Do style honest placeholder copy in italic, muted ink-soft (placeholderClass) wherever real content is missing, per the isPlaceholder convention — never fill a gap with an invented specific.
Do keep the recruiter fallback (SimpleFallback) genuinely chrome-free: base tokens and .link-underline only, no .soft-card, .menu-board, or .ticket-btn vocabulary borrowed back in.
donts: Don't place a label or eyebrow above an <h1>. An earlier draft put the 'TABLE STILL OPEN' label above the hero heading; it was corrected to sit beside/under the coffee-cup mark instead. The heading is always the first thing read.

Don't apply the ticket-chit's hard offset shadow to .soft-card, .menu-board, or any other surface — this world is coffeehouse/paper, not neobrutalist, and the hard shadow is earned only by the literal order-ticket vocabulary.

Don't spend chalkboard-green or brick outside the one material each is confined to (chalk = .menu-board only; brick is currently unused and reserved) — never repurpose either as a general UI or button color.

Don't introduce any literal show-branded asset — logo, character name or likeness, or the show's title typeface. The genre (coffeehouse, brick, couch terracotta, chalkboard, photo-strip framing) carries the reference; no trademarked asset does.
